main_text.head: EPISTOLA
main_text.p: argumento, ingenii quaero famam, qui ante me tanta arte & diligentia banc materi-am elaborarunt, elabora-tam illustrarunt, vt de eo-dem argumento agendi nullum sibi neque posteris locum reliquum feciffe vi-deantur. Verum, quemad-modum Ariftotelem à scri-bendo non deterruit ampli-tudo Platonis, neq; Cicero-nem M. Craffus, Antonius vel Hortenfius Oratores à Romano foro prohibuerút. In magnis enim conatibus pulcrum eft in mediis confi-ftere: fic & mihi vitio non verte-

page.notes: The ornamental marks above the heading and above the first lines of text are show-through or decoration from the reverse side and are left out. The first line reads "argumento, ingenii" with a comma after argumento; the printed spacing is slightly irregular. Some letters are faint, especially in "elaborarunt" and "illustrarunt". The long s is transcribed as a plain s throughout. The text is cut at the foot of the page by a tear in the paper, but no words appear to be lost. The final word "verte-" is broken at the line end and the continuation is on the next page.
